JUDGE GEORGE T CHOPPELAS, M BRADY, REPORTER, ASAUSA, CLERK 2:00PM C/C FOR SETTLEMENT CONFERENCE. ALL PARTIES PRESENT CASE SETTLED. TERMS AND CONDITIONS STATED ON RECORD. PLAINTIFF HAVE JUDGMENT FOR THE IMMDEDIATE POSSESSION OF THE PREMISES LOCATED AT 1541 CALIFORNIA STREET, #36, S.F, CA. AGREEMENT DECLARES FORFEITED. STAY OF EXECUTION ON THE CONDITION THAT DEFENDANT VACATE THE PREMISES ON OR BEFORE 5:00PM ON OCTOBER 11, 1994. IF DEFENDANT DOES NOT VACATES WRIT OF EXECUTION WILL BE ISSUED IMMEDIATELY. PLTF WILL HAVE JUDGMENT FOR UNPAID RENT OF $975.00 DAMAGES OF $10.83 PER DAY FROM SEPT 15, 1994 THROUGH OCT 11, 1994 ALONG WITH THE COSTS OF $80.00 FOR A TOTAL JUDGMENT OF $1,336.58. EACH PARTY WAIVES ANY CLAIM OF ACTION. ANY PERSONAL PROPERTY LEFT AT THE PREMISES AFTER OCT 11, 1994 IS DEEMED TO BE ABANDONED EACH SIDE WILL BEAR ITS OWN COSTS AND ATTORNEYS FEES.

THE COURT ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT MOORE, TOBIAS THE RESTITUTION AND POSSESSION OF THE PREMISES: 1541 CALIFORNIA STREET, #36, SAN FRANCISCO, CA $1,286.58 RENT, $80.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $1,366.58, STAYED UNTIL OCT-11-1994, LEASE FORFEITED, TOTAL JUDGMENT OF $1,336.58. SEE JUDGMENT FOR DETAILS.
